hits.snippet: US-based data science company Datavault AI has announced plans to acquire CyberCatch through an all-share transaction valued at around C$136.8m ($100m), following the signing of a binding letter of intent (LOI). ... hits.title: Datavault AI Buys CyberCatch in All-Stock Transaction
hits.snippet: Datavault AI Inc. and CyberCatch Holdings Inc. announced a binding letter of intent under which Datavault AI will acquire 100 percent of CyberCatch in an all-stock transaction. ... The deal values CyberCatch at approximately CAD $136.8 million (around $101 million). Upon closing, Datavault AI (Nasdaq: DVLT) shareholders are expected to own about 92.48 percent of the combined company, with CyberCatch shareholders holding 7.52 percent. The transaction remains subject to customary approvals, and CyberCatch will operate as a subsidiary from San Diego, with founder and CEO Sai Huda leading the unit under Datavault AI CEO Nathaniel T. Bradley.

Under the definitive agreement, Datavault AI will acquire all of CyberCatch’s issued and outstanding common shares, approximately 26.8 million shares, for USD $94,500,000 in cash, representing USD $3.53 per share to CyberCatch’s shareholders. All outstanding dilutive securities of CyberCatch will be exchanged on a cashless-exercise basis. extract.answer: USD $94.5 million in cash (USD $3.53 per CyberCatch share).
